name: TOPdesk - Search Knowledge Items
description: Configurable semantic search over a Qdrant collection populated by the TOPdesk ingest workflow.

parameters.jsCode:
// Keep these non-secret defaults aligned with the ingest workflow.
const embeddingUrl='http://litellm:4000/embeddings';const embeddingModel='govchat-embedding';const qdrantUrl='http://qdrant:6333';const vectorSize=3072;const input=$input.first()?.json||{};const question=String(input.question||input.query||'').trim();if(question.length<2)throw new Error('question must contain at least two characters');const integer=(v,d,min,max)=>{const n=Number(v);return Number.isFinite(n)?Math.max(min,Math.min(max,Math.floor(n))):d;};const threshold=Number(input.score_threshold);return [{json:{question,topK:integer(input.top_k,5,1,50),scoreThreshold:Number.isFinite(threshold)?Math.max(0,Math.min(1,threshold)):0.3,embeddingUrl,embeddingModel,qdrantUrl,collection:String(input.collection||'topdesk_knowledge_items'),vectorSize}}];

const cfg=$('1. Validate and configure search').first().json;const vector=$json.data?.[0]?.embedding;if(!Array.isArray(vector)||vector.length!==cfg.vectorSize)throw new Error('Embedding dimension mismatch: expected '+cfg.vectorSize+', received '+(Array.isArray(vector)?vector.length:'no vector'));return [{json:{...cfg,request:{vector,limit:cfg.topK,with_payload:true,with_vector:false,score_threshold:cfg.scoreThreshold,filter:{must:[{key:'source',match:{value:'topdesk'}},{key:'visible',match:{value:true}}]}}}}];

const cfg=$('3. Build vector query').first().json;const hits=Array.isArray($json.result)?$json.result:($json.result?.points||[]);const results=hits.map((hit,index)=>{const p=hit.payload||{};return {rank:index+1,score:hit.score,source_id:p.source_id||hit.id,knowledge_item_id:p.knowledge_item_id||p.source_id,attachment_name:p.attachment_name||null,number:p.number||null,title:p.title||null,content:p.content||'',visible:p.visible,url:p.url||null};});return [{json:{question:cfg.question,collection:cfg.collection,results,count:results.length}}];
